intent: fix ensure_git_hooks: surface HookShebangUnresolvable as degraded, not false-green ok
notes: Whiteboard finding on the 34ccfd7 hook-shebang commit (2026-08-28): `plan_hook_updates()` catches `HookShebangUnresolvable` and returns `[]`, but `[]` is indistinguishable from "no changes needed" at `ensure_git_hooks()`'s call site — so on machines the shebang fix is meant to protect, session-open returned `{'status': 'ok', 'detail': 'ok'}` instead of surfacing the refusal. My earlier audit ("graceful-degradation is inherited without additional wrapping") was wrong; the wrapping-at-plan/install-layer only helps the `gator update` path, not the session-open path.

Fix: `ensure_git_hooks()` in both `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-init.py` and its template twin now probes `gator_update._hook_shebang()` directly before calling `plan_hook_updates()`. If it raises `HookShebangUnresolvable`, returns `{'status': 'degraded', 'detail': 'hook shebang unresolvable: <exception message>', 'adds': 0, 'updates': 0}` — parallel shape to the pre-existing "gator-pre-commit.py missing" degraded case. Uses `getattr(gator_update, "HookShebangUnresolvable", None)` fallback so pre-fix template copies (which don't have the exception class) still work.

Regression pin: `tests/test_init.py::TestEnsureGitHooks::test_unresolvable_shebang_reports_degraded_not_ok`. Patches `init.import_sibling` to return a module with a raising `_hook_shebang` (not `patch.object(update, ...)` — `import_sibling` creates fresh module objects per call, no `sys.modules` caching, so patching the test's own reference wouldn't reach the copy `ensure_git_hooks` uses).

Updated `.gator/charters/scripts-repo-lifecycle.md` `ensure_git_hooks()` entry: added `HookShebangUnresolvable` to the degraded-triggers list, added `_hook_shebang()` as a defensive-probe callee, added a new TRIPWIRE bullet explaining why the probe is separate from the plan/install call and pointing at the whiteboard-finding date and pin.

Tests: `TestEnsureGitHooks` 4/4, broader adjacent sweep (test_init + test_hooks + test_layout + test_template_sync + test_session_hooks + test_session_open + test_update_entry_points) 195/195, zero regressions.
Third commit on the shebang-fix release train (34ccfd7 → a0a6c18 → this).
